ai.title: Per-response cap of 100 tool calls in agent runtime stream parser
ai.summary: The agent runtime stream parser now enforces a cap of 100 tool calls per response using the new `MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_RESPONSE` constant, cutting off runaway streams that previously could last for minutes and contain thousands of calls. When the limit is reached, the stream reader stops pulling chunks and cancels the underlying request, while appending a `TOOL_CALL_LIMIT` message to the conversation history to inform the model that its response was truncated. This change addresses specific failures where models streamed excessive tool calls, preventing the message history from growing beyond the compaction budget and causing subsequent turns to fail.
